title: Dave Page fired and Cobb wrongly blamed
summary: After Garrett got his audition Dave Page was given notice, bandmates blamed Cobb, and the gangster-like atmosphere helped him decide to leave; Page was his first trumpeter later.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now, we're getting ready to go downtown and open up at the Aquarium. Duke comes and pick me up. When we get into the Aquarium, Hamp sent him around the corner to
Manning's Music Store to get him a couple of (inaudible) Boy Meets the Horn, Cootie Williams, Duke Ellington, and Duke was a (inaudible) and Duke was a (inaudible) trumpet player.

Rex Stewart, okay, I'm sorry. And he tried to (inaudible) rehearsal, said, good. The next thing I know Dave Page got his notice. And I was blamed for it because Duke is hanging out with me. And we get in the station, train station, and Charlie Fulton. They were with Basie (inaudible). He's whispering about me, how dirty I was, what I did to Dave Page, and I don't know nothing.

But when this thing got to going so far, and what I tell you with the Curly Hammonds and the Versewis Harrison and Leroy the Ballet, and they all got real gangsterized over there, I says, time to leave.
When I left to form my band, the first man I had on trumpet was Dave Page.
You know Dave (inaudible) my band, don't you?
So did Dave think -- did he at one time?
